claims.evidence: PRIDE file list has 19 RAW files + MaxQuantOutput.tar.gz; every RAW appears in Rab7_ExpDesign.txt; each file listed once per SILAC channel (L/M/H).

claims.location: characteristics[biological replicate]; source name suffix rep1/rep2
claims.value: 1 = Exp1 files (MaxQuant experiment rab7mu1); 2 = Exp2 files (MaxQuant experiment rab7mu2)
claims.evidence: ExpDesign maps Exp1_* -> rab7mu1 and Exp2_* -> rab7mu2; paper: 'From two biological replicates showing good correlation (Supplementary Fig. 6b)'. RAW headers: deposited Exp2_* files were acquired as Exp3_* (same date, fraction and injection suffix for all 11) - a consistent rename, no swaps.

claims.location: comment[label] / source name / characteristics[genotype] / characteristics[treatment] / factor values
claims.value: SILAC light = GFP-RAB7A wild type, untreated; SILAC medium = GFP-RAB7A wild type, EGF 8 min; SILAC heavy = GFP-RAB7A Y183F, EGF 8 min
claims.evidence: Supplementary Fig. 6a: GFP-RAB7 Lys0/Arg0; + EGF 8 min: GFP-RAB7 Lys4/Arg6 and GFP-RAB7 Y183F Lys8/Arg10; SILAC mix 1:1:1. Supp. Fig. 6e column headers: Intensity Light (Ctrl), Medium (8'EGF), Heavy (8'EGF) with wildtype/Y183F rows. peptides.txt has Ratio M/L, H/L, H/M (triplex).
ExpDesign Fraction column; SDS-PAGE separation then in-gel digestion (Supp. Fig. 6a, Methods). Re-injection rows (F2b, F4b, F7b, F4c) set by a documented post-processing step to 2, 4, 7, 4.

claims.value: 1 for F1-F7; 2 for F1b (rep1) and F2b/F4b/F7b (rep2); 3 for F4c (rep2)
claims.evidence: ExpDesign assigns F1b->fraction 1, F2b->2, F4b->4, F4c->4, F7b->7 within the same experiment, i.e. re-injections of the same gel slice; b/c suffix and later acquisition dates in file names.
Methods: 'Eluates were then combined and resolved on SDS-PAGE and in-gel digested with trypsin'; PRIDE:0000568 is a descendant of PRIDE:0000550.

All 19 RAW headers: 'Q Exactive Plus - Orbitrap MS'; paper: 'Q-Exactive Plus (for RAB7 interactome analysis)'; PRIDE protocol says QExactive Plus while the PRIDE instrument field says Q Exactive (overridden).

claims.location: comment[proteomics data acquisition method], comment[dissociation method], comment[collision energy], comment[ms2 mass analyzer], comment[ms1 scan range]
claims.evidence: Instrument method in RAW header: Full MS / dd-MS2 TopN 10, MS1 resolution 70,000 scan range 300 to 1750 m/z, dd-MS2 resolution 35,000, NCE 25 (Fragmentation_HCD 25); paper: data-dependent acquisition.
Methods: in-gel digested with trypsin. peptides.txt: 2084 peptides whose only internal K/R precede P are counted as 1 missed cleavage, which MaxQuant does only with Trypsin/P; 'Special AAs KR'.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; variable Oxidation M, Acetyl Protein N-term, Gln->pyro-Glu, Phospho STY, GG K, Tyr->Phe Y; SILAC Label:2H(4) K, Label:13C(6) R, Label:13C(6)15N(2) K, Label:13C(6)15N(4) R
claims.evidence: parameters.txt: Fixed modifications Carbamidomethyl (C); 'Modifications included in protein quantification: Acetyl (Protein N-term);Gln->pyro-Glu;Oxidation (M)'; 'Site tables: GlyGly (K)Sites;Oxidation (M)Sites;Phospho (STY)Sites;Tyr->PheSites'; peptides.txt has GlyGly (K)/Oxidation (M)/Phospho (STY)/Tyr->Phe site ID columns. SILAC labels Lys4/Arg6, Lys8/Arg10 from Supp. Fig. 6a. UNIMOD accessions verified in OLS (4, 35, 1, 28, 21, 121, 678, 481, 188, 259, 267).
parameters.txt 'MS/MS tol. (FTMS) 20 ppm'; MS2 acquired in the Orbitrap (FTMS).
MaxQuant 1.4.1.4 parameters.txt does not record precursor (first/main search) tolerance; no mqpar.xml or summary.txt deposited.

claims.location: characteristics[cell line], [cellosaurus accession], [cellosaurus name], [organism], [organism part], [cell type], [disease], [age], [sex]
claims.value: HeLa; CVCL_0030; HeLa; Homo sapiens; uterine cervix; epithelial cell; endocervical adenocarcinoma; 30Y6M; female
claims.evidence: Methods: 'Human epithelial cervix carcinoma HeLa cells ... purchased from ATCC'; 'HeLa cells were labeled in SILAC DMEM'. Cellosaurus CVCL_0030: DI NCIt C27677 HPV-related endocervical adenocarcinoma, SX Female, AG 30Y6M. MONDO:0000554 endocervical adenocarcinoma, UBERON:0000002, CL:0000066 checked in OLS.
Methods: SILAC DMEM (PAA Laboratories) lacking arginine and lysine; NCIT:C185409.
'+ EGF 8 min.' in Supp. Fig. 6a; 'stimulated cells transfected either with wt or mutant RAB7 with EGF for 8 min'. Interpreted as time after stimulation at harvest.
EFO:0003298 epidermal growth factor (100 ng/mL per Methods). 'untreated' is the sample-metadata template's own control example; not an ontology term (validator warning).
Cellosaurus OX line carries no population annotation (only a genome-ancestry comment); paper does not state passage number.

limitations: PRIDE structured instrument field (Q Exactive) disagrees with RAW headers and paper (Q Exactive Plus); RAW headers used.
Deposited Exp2_* file names were renamed from acquisition names Exp3_*; grouping follows the deposited MaxQuant experiment design (rab7mu2) which covers exactly these 11 files.
Precursor mass tolerance not recorded in the deposited MaxQuant 1.4 parameters.txt.
Reduction/alkylation reagents not stated (in-gel digestion 'as described'); columns omitted although Carbamidomethyl (C) was a fixed search modification.
GFP-trap immunoprecipitation has no fitting term under EFO:0009090; characteristics[enrichment process] omitted and the IP is described in the report.
Fraction identifiers of 12 re-injection rows were set by post-processing from Rab7_ExpDesign.txt because build numbers fractions by position.

sdrf-tools reconcile reports cleavage_agent_unsupported because the PRIDE record prose never names an enzyme; the paper Methods (trypsin) and the deposited search (Trypsin/P behaviour) support the value.
Supplementary Tables were not opened; the channel map comes from Supplementary Fig. 6a/6e (figure image read at 300 dpi).
